# Parry

> Parry keeps leveraged positions on NEAR from being liquidated, and runs a delta-neutral NEAR vault. A guardian program in an OutLayer TEE watches each protected position, plans a rescue, has a NEAR AI Cloud verifiable model review it, and signs it with a key bound to its build; the person's account contract accepts only protective actions within their on-chain mandate. It runs on NEAR testnet.

Parry has two products.

- Protect: a protected account (a NEP-655 universal account, owned by a passkey or a NEAR account) holds a Rhea lending position, and optionally a Hyperliquid perp and an Aave loan on Base Sepolia through Chain Signatures. The owner sets a mandate: which protective powers the guardian has (repay, add collateral, deleverage, reduce or hedge a perp, repay the Aave loan), per-token reserve and daily caps, a daily action count and an expiry, with the trigger thresholds and the order of rescue steps sealed to the enclave. The guardian can never transfer funds to anyone. The owner can close a position (selling collateral in rounds that each keep health above 1, or repaying from a wallet) or unwind the whole account at any time.
- Earn: the vault stakes NEAR into LiNEAR and shorts the NEAR perp on Hyperliquid through Chain Signatures, so its value tracks dollars plus staking yield and funding. Shares are the NEP-141 token EARN. The enclave publishes the vault's risk score and a proof-of-reserves Merkle root on chain, and the vault pauses deposits when the risk is high. Its one fee: 10% of positive yield funds an insurance fund that pays only negative funding streaks, hedge slippage beyond the band and margin top-ups, under caps.

The enclave also signs private health certificates: "health is at least X" for one named reader at one block until an expiry, with no amounts, optionally anchored on the risk board. Parry's risk model was replayed through six real NEAR crashes (median 24.5 hours of warning before liquidation; 5 of 6 liquidations avoided).

Every guardian action carries the SHA-256 hash of the AI review that approved it. The review is bound to the exact request and response bytes by the model's TEE signature, so anyone can check it.

## Use it from an agent

- [MCP server](https://github.com/Aliyaan-Nasir/Parry/blob/main/packages/mcp/README.md): `npx -y @parry/mcp` (from a clone: `pnpm -F @parry/mcp build && node packages/mcp/dist/bin.js`), or Streamable HTTP at `https://api.parry.market/mcp`. Read tools: risk_check, get_position_risk, get_market, get_vault, get_reserves, get_guardian_log, verify_guardian_decision, simulate_rescue, get_rescue_route, get_status, get_rates, get_crash_replay, get_liquidation_heatmap, get_prices, verify_record, verify_certificate, get_closing, get_incidents, get_route_savings, list_watched. Capped testnet write tools: create_protected_account, set_mandate, vault_deposit, vault_withdraw, close_position, unwind_account, paid_risk_check (pays over x402 on NEAR), watch_account, unwatch_account, issue_certificate.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/Aliyaan-Nasir/Parry/blob/main/skills/parry/SKILL.md): teaches Claude Code and Codex to use and extend Parry (`npx skills add Aliyaan-Nasir/Parry`).

## Use it from code

- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/Aliyaan-Nasir/Parry/blob/main/packages/sdk/README.md): `@parry/sdk` reads the API and the chain, builds every contract call as plain data for a wallet to sign, seals mandate policies to the enclave, and verifies guardian decisions and reserve proofs.
- [HTTP API](https://github.com/Aliyaan-Nasir/Parry/blob/main/docs/api.md): JSON under `/v1` at `https://api.parry.market` (testnet). Main reads: `/v1/risk/{accountId}` (any NEAR account's lending risk), `/v1/accounts/{accountId}`, `/v1/guardian/decisions`, `/v1/guardian/decisions/{id}/verify`, `/v1/vault`, `/v1/vault/reserves`, `/v1/vault/insurance`, `/v1/market`, `/v1/rates`, `/v1/prices`, `/v1/heatmap` (where Rhea borrowers would be liquidated, mainnet or testnet), `/v1/replay`, `/v1/verify/{id}` (a decision, certificate or transaction), `/v1/certificates`, `/v1/status`; live updates as Server-Sent Events at `/v1/stream`. `/v1/paid/risk/{accountId}` is the same risk check paid per call over x402 on NEAR.

## How it works

- [Risk model](https://github.com/Aliyaan-Nasir/Parry/blob/main/docs/risk-model.md): health, liquidation price, the Tremor volatility index, first-passage liquidation probability, time to liquidation, cascade pressure and the 0 to 100 score with its tiers.
- [Architecture and NEAR primitives](https://github.com/Aliyaan-Nasir/Parry/blob/main/AGENTS.md): where each primitive lives in the code (universal accounts, global contracts, passkeys on chain, Chain Signatures, MPC foreign-transaction verification, OutLayer, NEAR AI Cloud, gas keys, post-quantum ML-DSA-65 keys, NEP-366 relaying, x402, NEAR Intents, the Agent Market).
- [Security](https://github.com/Aliyaan-Nasir/Parry/blob/main/SECURITY.md): the trust model and every review finding.
